metadata.title: Maximum speed of hypervelocity stars ejected from binaries

notes: No individual star meets the eligibility criteria. The HVS populations discussed (late-type B stars and G/K-dwarf HVS candidates; T:p1-b6, T:p2-b0 and I:p2-b0) are unnamed samples, and the histogram in I:p2-b0 provides no individual identifiers. HD 271791 is named only at T:p4-b8 as a previously proposed candidate for ejection from a binary via a supernova, with an alternative interpretation; the paper does not select or analyze it as a Galactic unbound candidate or establish that it satisfies an unbound criterion. The fast pulsars in T:p4-b3 (B2011+38, B2224+65, IGR J11014−6103, B1508+55) are cited only as evidence for large neutron-star kicks, not as Galactic unbound candidates.
